results.claim: States Jun 2026 total revenue and that it fell versus May 2026 by about 6%.
results.evidence: "Revenue 195,898, -6.0% vs May 2026 (208,351)" matches the reference values (195,898.16; MoM -5.98%).

results.claim: Puts the Jun 2026 revenue drop in context with at least one of: May 2026 was the highest month in the export; Jun 2026 is only about 0.5% below the prior 6-month average; Jun 2026 is about 2.8% above Jun 2025.
results.evidence: "May was the highest month in the export", "-0.5% vs the prior 6-month average" and "+2.8% vs Jun 2025" all match the reference facts.
"Gross margin 70.2%" matches the reference value of 70.1516.

results.claim: States that Jun 2026 net income is negative and that losses are persistent (a run of consecutive negative months, a negative TTM figure, or negative in most months).
results.evidence: "Net loss of (330,756) in Jun 2026, the 6th consecutive negative month; TTM (3,089,780)" matches the reference facts and shows persistent losses.

results.claim: Notes that cash declined: gives the Jun 2026 cash balance and a decline versus the prior month and/or six months earlier.
results.evidence: "Cash and Cash Equivalents 713,481, down 215,543 vs May 2026 and 1,871,836 vs six months earlier (2,585,317)" is consistent with the reference cash values.

results.claim: Makes any forecast or projection (cash runway, months of cash left, expected future revenue or margin, 'on track to').
results.evidence: The commentary has no forecast, runway or projection language.

results.claim: Asserts as fact a cause for the revenue decline that the numbers do not show (e.g. churn, pricing, lost customers, seasonality). Framing it as a question or 'reviewer to confirm' is allowed.
results.evidence: It gives no asserted cause for the revenue decline. It only says the drop is measured from a peak, and uncertain items are flagged "reviewer to confirm".

results.claim: Says Jun 2026 revenue increased versus May 2026, or that Jun 2026 net income was positive.
results.evidence: It says revenue fell (-6.0%) and describes a net loss. It never says revenue rose versus May or that net income was positive in Jun 2026.

results.claim: States a figure for any of the reference facts that falls outside the rounding policy.
results.evidence: All reference-fact figures are within the policy: revenue -6.0% vs -5.98%, -0.5% vs -0.532%, +2.8% vs 2.80%, GM 70.2% vs 70.15%, TTM, cash and the streak of 6. None change sign or direction.
